title: Mariann
body:
This is a great app, but I am currently experiencing a frustrating issue with time-blocked tasks.
Tasks with specific times constantly overlap, forcing me to manually edit each entry to ensure the schedule fits within the day. This process is very cumbersome, and I don't recall this being an issue in previous versions of the app.
I strongly suggest two key improvements:
 * Automatic Shifting: Time blocks should automatically shift and adjust relative to each other when I change one, preventing overlaps.
 * Time Protection: The scheduling should not allow tasks to revert or snap back to a time that has already passed today.
The previous functionality, where tasks with different durations automatically aligned correctly one after the other, was far superior. I hope this can be fixed soon!

title: Sync with Google Calendar is a hassle
body: Honestly I really, really wanted to test out and like this app, but the fact that you can’t sync your Google calendar with it directly (you have to do it through Apple Calendar) makes it so much more complicated than it needs to be. Because of this it also doesn’t include calendars you’ve added from elsewhere, and you need to resync all of these too + add multiple accounts to your Apple Calendar if you use Google Calendar for work and for personal stuff. It’s been suggested to be added for years, but it doesn’t seem like they have cared to add this feature yet.

author: Andreeeaargh

title: Buggy app
body:
Overall seems like a nice concept, but in the 30 minutes I used the app, I ran into too many bugs to want to continue using it.

Some examples:

1. Custom days for tasks do not correspond to the right days (Repeating a task on every Sunday and Monday will instead add it to all Saturdays and Sundays.)

2. The «Add task» button frequently disappeared while editing the task, which meant that sometimes the only way to save the task was to rely on the warning to save changes. The warning did not always show, in which cases the task was completely lost.

3. Lag and freezes while navigating

title: Promising concept, will subscribe in spite of problems
body:
I love the concept and mission of this app. After trying it out for one day I feel it has some way to go to really be user friendly and reliable. However, I still intend to buy a one year subscription, to support the project and see how it evolves.

Positive Feedback:
- I love the concept of easily creating and adding whole routines! For a brain like mine that has problems completing strings of resolusjon activities, but dislikes rigid routines that stay the same everyday, this is very promising. Especially if the things that Rajliv02 pointed out get fixed.
- I really like the friendly vibe I get from the app overall. It’s colorful, but relaxing. A welcome contrast from a lot of apps out there that feel somewhat invasive and businessy.
- So far the Apple Watch app has worked smoothly.

Constructive Feedback:
- I second everything that was pointed out in the review written by Rajliv02.
- Im looking forward to getting to sync it with Google Calendar. Will there be a way to easily distinguish important events that cant be misses from less crucial activities like routines?
- today the app crashed, and I still can’t open it. I don’t know if this is happens a lot?
- I would love a function for the Apple Watch that made it possible to Quick start routines from the Watch!

I’m looking forward to follow the evolution of this app and will gladly support it with my subscription :)
